jobs.title: Sr. Operations Specialist – Launch Team
jobs.description_text: About the Role Skydio is seeking a Readiness Specialist to get our dock customers from signed opportunity to a running program. You will own a book of accounts within a region, from large cities to small towns, and project manage each customer through everything that has to be true before a dock flies: the site, the network, the policy and approvals behind the program, the flight operation that will run it, and a clean handoff to Customer Success. Most of that work is done by other people, inside the customer and inside Skydio, and none of them report to you. The job is building the relationships that get it done, and holding the date. This is a remote role. Travel of 50 to 60% is required to support site surveys, customer engagements, deployments, team onsites, and company events. About the Team The Launch Team is the operational arm of Skydio's dock business. We sit between the opportunity and the running program, and readiness means everything a customer needs to launch. We do not perform every piece of that work, but we project manage the customer to all of it and are accountable for the date. Readiness starts before the contract is signed. Much of it runs on calendar time Skydio does not control, such as an engineering study, a purchase order, or an MOU in legal review, so the earlier it starts, the sooner the dock is in the ground. jobs.title: Program Manager, Major Deployments
jobs.description_text: About the role Skydio builds autonomous drones. Our largest commercial customers run global logistics and site security operations, and they're moving from one-off drone flights to standing programs that run every day across dozens of sites. Getting there takes more than shipping hardware. That's this role. You'll own commercial deployments end to end: planning, rollout, operational handoff, and the stabilization period after go-live. You'll work directly with the customer's operators and safety leads to build the procedures, training, and maintenance practices a program needs to run without you. And you'll bring what you learn in the field back to Product and Engineering. The work spans piloted operations and dock-based remote operations. It sits at the intersection of hardware, software, operations, and aviation compliance, and there is no playbook yet for much of it. You should be comfortable writing one. jobs.description_text: About the role: As a Skydio products ambassador, you will work in a small team of high-performing individuals who provide UAS system and Cloud operational best practices, deep feature diagnostics to Skydio commercial, state & local government customers. You’ll work both remotely and at customer sites with Skydio hardware and software products performing device firmware troubleshooting, mission usage / configuration optimization, and 1st / 3rd party cloud network optimization and/or issue diagnostics. Utilizing log analysis tools, customer incident tickets and internal documentations, you will use your technical troubleshooting skills to determine the root cause of various flight and skill (e.g., media streaming, 3D scan) issues, provide mitigation recommendations to customers, and collaborate with product teams to drive product enhancements. By taking ownership of customer relationships in the field and collecting feedback, you will be a trusted partner and liaison between Skydio Program Management, Product, Support and Engineering teams. This is a hybrid role. You will own new deployments end to end, and you will also serve as the frontline technical expert when customers hit issues: on-device firmware troubleshooting, mission configuration and optimization, and first- and third-party cloud network diagnostics. Using log analysis, incident tickets, and internal documentation, you will determine root cause of flight and media streaming issues, recommend mitigations, and drive resolution with our product and engineering teams. You will be the bridge between Japanese customers and Skydio's engineering organization in the U.S., which means both deep technical capability and the communication skills to represent each side accurately to the other. This role reports into the Japan organization while collaborating with the Deployment Engineering organization and Customer Support organization. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Rips (Web)
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE Rips is one of the fastest growing apps in the collectibles space, and it lives on mobile today. You're going to bring it to the web. This is a greenfield build on top of backend systems that already work at scale. You'll own the web platform: the architecture, the conventions, the component patterns, the performance budget. The engineers who come after you will build inside the foundation you set, so we're looking for someone who has done this before. You'll be the first dedicated web engineer, but you won't be alone. Our engineers are deep in React already, and you'll be partnering with backend engineers who have spent the last two years building the systems you'll be consuming. What's missing is someone who owns the web surface end to end and has strong opinions about how it should be built. What You'll Do - Ship Rips on web, building on existing backend systems and APIs. - Set the technical foundation for our web platform: architecture, state management, build tooling, component patterns, testing strategy, and the standards that keep quality high as the team grows. - Own the user experience, not just the implementation. Motion, micro interactions, responsive behavior, and load performance are yours to get right. - Partner with backend engineers on API and data model design. You'll push back when a contract makes the client worse. - Create leverage. The patterns you establish should make the next feature faster to build and make it obvious to a mid level engineer

The Team: Since its founding by Ruth Bader Ginsburg in 1972, the ACLU’s Women’s Rights Project has been a trailblazer in fighting for gender equity under law. We engage in systemic legal reform to ensure that everyone has the freedom to live, work, and learn free from stereotypes, harassment, and violence based on sex.
